pages.title: Home
pages.excerpt: The home of Shakespeare Middle East Café & Restaurant.

data.body:
In 2001, Aline Abtour brought a touch of fairytale charm to Dubai with Shakespeare & Co. It is a café where vintage furniture is the new trend, chandeliers glowed warmly, and every classic dish and freshly baked pastries told a story. For over two decades, it became the city’s beloved retreat, a place for first dates and friendships that lasted lifetimes.

When the original chapter closed in 2023, it felt like the end of an era.

But legends don’t fade, they evolve.

Now, under Platinum Hospitality Management, spearheaded by CEO Ahmad Atwi, Shakespeare Middle East Café & Restaurant is rekindling that magic. The soul remains the same – thoughtful food, clink of cutlery and quiet laughter, and that unmistakable warmth, but with a fresh vision for the future.

This isn’t just a homecoming. It’s a new beginning.
data.side_text: Shakespeare Middle East reimagines the legacy of its classic predecessor, offering a refined retreat where literature and leisure intertwine. Located in the vibrant Bawabat Al Sharq, it’s a haven for those who appreciate the aroma of freshly brewed coffee, inspired cuisine, and delectable French pastries. The ambiance is a blend of old-world charm and contemporary comfort, invites guests to linger over meals, conversations. Here, every visit feels like stepping into a story where culture, taste, and timeless elegance converge.

items.title: International Food
items.body: Experience a grand culinary adventure in the heart of the UAE. We unite classic comforts and modern favorites on one exciting menu. Savor everything from a lavish American breakfast and gourmet burgers to succulent lamb shank and delicate French pastries, ending with the aromatic ritual of Moroccan tea. This celebration of world flavors framed in historic charm.

items.title: Relaxing Shisha Lounge
items.body: Discover the height of lounge luxury with our premium shisha service. Set within elegant Victorian decor, we elevate the timeless tradition with an extensive menu of exceptional flavors. Choose from classic favorites to inventive house-specialty blends, each prepared with precision for perfect purity and lasting flavor. Designed for the discerning guest, it’s the definitive way to unwind, a seamless blend of heritage, comfort, and vibrant social atmosphere.

items.title: Great Location & Ambiance
items.body: Step into a Victorian-era sanctuary in the heart of the mall. Our flagship restaurant at Bawabat Al Sharq Mall offers a complete experience of dine-in elegance and vibrant terrace dining. Your neighborhood gourmet stop, right where you live and work. Nestled within the vibrant Radiant Square residential and office tower at Podium 7, our express branch brings exceptional, chef-crafted flavours to your doorstep. Perfect for a quick lunch between meetings, a takeaway dinner after a long day, or a casual meal by the community pool. Quality dining, seamlessly integrated into your urban lifestyle.

items.title: Friendly Hospitality
items.body: We believe the finest ingredient in any restaurant is a heartfelt welcome. Our team provides hospitality that is both attentive and refreshingly genuine. Expect warm smiles, knowledgeable recommendations, and service that anticipates your needs without intrusion. Whether you’re here for a leisurely three-course meal, a quick business lunch, or a relaxing shisha evening, we are dedicated to making your experience seamless and personally memorable. Your comfort is our priority.

pages.title: About Us
pages.excerpt: The story of Shakespeare Middle East.

data.body:
Shakespeare Middle East proudly carries forward the legacy of a beloved café-restaurant concept first established in Dubai in 2001. After two decades of influencing the F&B space and setting a standard for sophisticated, casual dining, we are excited to usher in a new era under fresh ownership.

The story of Shakespeare continues, now guided by a focused vision for the future. We have refined our offerings, ensuring that the acclaimed culinary tradition, featuring classic and contemporary fare inspired by the world’s most beloved cuisines is richer than ever. Our current flagship location is open and welcoming guests at Bawabat Al Sharq Mall.

The unique Shakespeare aesthetic is the elegant blend of refinement and cosiness designed to evoke the charm of bygone eras is being carefully maintained and thoughtfully integrated into our new spaces.

A visit to Shakespeare Middle East is an experience for the senses. Complementing our core restaurant offering is our renowned patisserie, crafted in-house using artisanal techniques and the finest ingredients. Guests can indulge in an exceptional range of classic French pastries, including petit fours.

We remain dedicated to creating memorable experiences and becoming an integral part of the communities we serve.

items.title: Our Core Values
items.body: We stay true to the rich culinary traditions of the world. Our chefs use classic recipes, fresh ingredients, and traditional cooking techniques to bring you flavors that feel just like home.

items.title: Quality
items.body: Quality is our main ingredient. It’s in our from-scratch kitchen, our attentive service and the care we take in creating a memorable dining experience for every guest.

items.title: Hospitality
items.body: At Shakespeare, you’re not just a customer, you’re our guest. Our team is dedicated to providing friendly service, a warm atmosphere, and a dining experience that makes you feel welcome.

items.title: Community
items.body: Food is meant to bring people together. Whether it’s a family meal, a gathering with friends, or a quiet moment with a cup of coffee, Shakespeare is a place where connections are made and memories are shared.

pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.content:
Privacy Policy for Saffron & Thyme

Last updated: September 2026

At Saffron & Thyme, accessible from our official website, one of our main priorities is the privacy of our visitors. This Privacy Policy document contains types of information that is collected and recorded by Saffron & Thyme and how we use it.

Information We Collect

When you place a table reservation or submit an inquiry through our contact form, we collect your name, email address, phone number, and any dining preferences you choose to share.

How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect in various ways, including to:

  • Confirm, manage, and facilitate table reservations and private dining requests
  • Send confirmation notices and event updates
  • Improve and personalize your dining experience
  • Communicate with you for customer support

pages.title: Franchise
pages.excerpt: Bring Shakespeare Middle East to a new destination.

data.body:
The Shakespeare Middle East franchise is built upon the strong legacy of the original homegrown brand, founded in Dubai in 2001. Its return represents a strategic evolution, transforming deep-rooted customer affinity and instant market recognition into a solid foundation for new business.

Partners gain access to a complete and refined operational system, proven over decades, along with our distinctive design and full training support. This opportunity is defined by a respected brand name that naturally drives loyalty, providing a significant advantage in developing a successful and enduring hospitality destination.

faqs.question: What is the dress code at Saffron & Thyme?
faqs.answer: We recommend smart casual to elegant evening attire. We respectfully request gentlemen avoid athletic sportswear, flip-flops, or baseball caps in our main dining room.

faqs.question: How far in advance should I make a reservation?
faqs.answer: We accept reservations up to 60 days in advance via our online booking form or telephone. For Friday and Saturday evenings, reserving 2-3 weeks in advance is highly recommended.

faqs.question: Can you accommodate dietary restrictions and allergies?
faqs.answer: Yes, absolutely. Our menu features clear markers for vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free diets. Please inform us of any severe allergies when reserving so our executive chef can prepare custom accommodations.

faqs.question: Is valet parking available?
faqs.answer: Complimentary valet parking is provided at our front entrance every evening beginning at 5:00 PM Thursday through Sunday.

faqs.question: Do you host private events and wedding receptions?
faqs.answer: Yes, our Private Dining Room accommodates up to 40 seated guests, and full restaurant buyouts are available for up to 120 guests. Inquire through our contact page.

faqs.question: What is your corkage fee policy?
faqs.answer: Guests are welcome to bring special bottles from their private cellars that are not represented on our wine list. Our corkage fee is $45 per 750ml bottle, with a two-bottle maximum per party.
